Bretzel, please provide a demo next time, its much faster then taking 13 screenshots.
It's really simple, follow these steps:


  • Open your console
  • If you have opened the console, type:
    record YOURDEMONAME
  • If you want to stop the recording, open the console again and type:
    stop
  • Your demo should be finished by now, if you want to watch your own demo, open the console and type:
    playdemo YOURDEMONAME


Your demo should be a .dem file, which you can find in your CS:GO folder.
For example, this is my filepath:
F:\Steam\steamapps\common\Counter-Strike Global Offensive\csgo


In this example, I would've had a file called YOURDEMONAME.dem in my Counter-Strike Global Offensive \ csgo - folder.


You can then upload the file to a service you like, for example Zippyshare / Dropbox, or in the Up & Download Channel of our TeamSpeak³ Server.



P.S.: An alle Admins, ihr könnt diese Anleitung gerne anderen Spielern zeigen, die nicht wissen, wie man eine Demo aufnimmt. Wenn ihr diese Anleitung referenzieren wollt, hier ist der Permalink zu genau diesem Post.
